# Fixtures

Deterministic test fixtures belong here after their source, purpose, and
regeneration process are approved.

Reviewed project-model fixtures live under `tests/fixtures/project-model/`.
They exercise current schema version `0.2.0`, legacy `0.1.0` migration,
canonical units, provenance, roundtrip behavior, invalid schema cases, and
invalid referential-integrity cases.

CAD output fixtures are still deferred. STEP, STP, and STL fixtures may be added
later only under approved test-fixture locations.
